projects.name: OverSearchGuard
projects.summary: Conflict-aware evidence thinning for search-augmented LLMs (RAG / agents).
highlights: CACT: conflict-aware candidate thinning with source weights, recency decay, contradiction penalties, and anti-dup cap-per-source.
BEA: budgeted evidence accumulation for cost-aware decisions (TPC).
Reproducible benchmark: accuracy 0.143 → 0.970 while reducing avg tokens 491.5 → 117.3 (flan-t5-small, n=300).

projects.name: FlashToken
projects.summary: Tokenizer-side prefix caching for low-latency LLM systems (tiktoken).
highlights: FixedPrefix + AppendOnly caching strategies for long-prefix reuse and append-only chat.
27×–37× speedup on long context reuse scenarios with mismatches = 0 (token-by-token equality).

projects.name: Turbo-Softmax
projects.summary: High-precision fast Softmax kernel in C for generic MCUs.
highlights: Range reduction via IEEE-754 bit-level manipulation and 5th-order polynomial exp approximation.
4.0×–4.2× speedup over standard math.h implementations; max error < 1e-6.
